title: Mixifore language
extract: Mixifore, or Mogofin, is a minor Mande language of Guinea. Mixiforé is a branch of Mandingos language spoken in the Boké region. It is a part of the group of Western Mandingos, in which they migrated from Fouta Djallon under the Fulani's migration.
